25.original: Place low-quality fire crystals at the designated locations.

48.original: We have much to learn about this world. Let us see what else Visna has to share.

49.original: For a while I wasn't sure how we would fare, but it seems luck was on our side. Now we have an airship...albeit with a slew of caveats.

50.original: Back in the First, we had the Crystal Exarch to smooth over our introductions. Having no such assistance here, I must confess to feeling somewhat nervous.

51.original: Speaking of inhabitants of other reflections...the voidsent of the Thirteenth. They're generally aware of the Source and its peoples, but I suppose having no familiarity with those from another world would be the norm.

52.original: Right, let's go speak with Ketill! ...Is what I would say, but my crewmates still appear to be wary of you all.

53.original: Seeing as that wariness is why I'm getting an extra cut, just to be considerate, it'd be best if you stay put. I'll have the captain come over instead.

54.original: Captain! There's something I want to discuss with you!

55.original: Come over here! It's perfectly safe, I promise!

56.original: Well, I'll be damned... To think that there were unbranded folk...

57.original: See? It's fine, just like I said!

58.original: So, what'd you want to discuss?

59.original: First of all, we wish to apologize for any trouble we have caused. And if I may, I would explain our situation.

60.original: Uh huh... Frankly, I don't know what to think about all this “other world” stuff...

61.original: But it's true that you don't have brands. You're clearly not ordinary folk, and I reckon you could do worse than meeting Visna's master.

62.original: That being the case, we'll take you to <hex:021A020203>Naglfar<hex:021A020103>─as the stranded survivors you are.

65.original: That said, we won't be setting off just yet. This isle here's perfect for our needs.

66.original: It's our duty to gather resources in this expanse.

67.original: <hex:021A020203>Naglfar<hex:021A020103> has ships dedicated to securing materials, you see. Each vessel is assigned crew members─the captain, the pilot, the runesmith, and so on.

68.original: And it's our merry band that's been assigned to <hex:021A020203>Glaðr<hex:021A020103>!

69.original: So you will mine resources from this isle.

70.original: If you are not averse to the offer, might we assist with your work?

71.original: While poor repayment for our debt, we wish to be of service rather than sit idly by.

72.original: Well now, I won't turn down extra pairs of hands. Here, take these.

73.original: They're warm... Are these fire-aspected crystals?

74.original: Aye. Far from the purest stuff, but they've been treated to produce more heat.

75.original: As preparation for the extraction, I'd like you to set these crystals all over.

76.original: I'll have to move <hex:021A020203>Glaðr<hex:021A020103> away from the isle for the next step, so Visna will supervise here. You have any questions, you can take them to her.

77.original: Understood. We shall begin at once.

79.original: From my cursory knowledge of the subject, the mining process here appears to differ from that of the Source. It will be interesting to see how it unfolds.

80.original: While there are those in Eorzea who dwell amidst the clouds, they may descend to the surface as necessary. To think that it has been impossible here for centuries...

81.original: While you set the fire crystals, the two of us will inspect the isle. Come and find me once you've finished.

82.original: Oh, and take care not to slip and fall off the edge. You might get lucky and land on another isle...but I wouldn't bet my life on it.

83.original: In light of the battle, we need to assess the integrity of the isle's bedrock. Wouldn't want the whole thing to suddenly fall apart!

84.original: I've finished setting my allocation of crystals. If you have as well, let us report to Visna.

85.original: I wonder why <hex:021A020203>Glaðr<hex:021A020103> had to move away from the isle. If they're extracting resources, would it not make more sense to leave the ship where it was?

86.original: The bedrock appears to be sound, I'm happy to report. We can safely proceed!

87.original: Oh, you've finished already? That was fast... Do you do this sort of thing often?

88.original: An adventurer? I've never heard of such a profession. Traveling the world and taking on odd jobs... Such a life would be unthinkable here.

89.original: Tell me... Where you're from, are people free to travel as far as they like?

90.original: Or is it because you're capable that you can do that? Can travel so far, you can even come to another world...

91.original: ...Sorry. We've only just met, and you're still trying to make sense of everything, yet here I am bombarding you with strange questions.

92.original: Thanks for taking care of the crystals so quickly! The captain should return very soon, so sit tight for now!
